h1: USABAI Riverside Boutique Hotel — a riverside boutique in the city centre within walking reach of Chanthaboon Riverside
intro: If you want a Chanthaburi stay that's right in the city, easy to drive to, yet still has a quiet riverside corner to sit out in the evening, USABAI Riverside Boutique Hotel (Yu Sabai Riverside) is a name that keeps coming up · This 3-star riverside boutique hotel beside the Chanthaburi River is built around a 'Contemporary Chanthaburi' design idea, with 32 rooms in 7 individually styled types, a riverside walkway and salas, a café and free parking · The part guests love most: it's a short walk to the Chanthaboon Riverside community and the night market · Rooms start from about THB 1,000/night, which is very fair for a boutique in this spot.

body.html: People come to Chanthaburi to wander the Chanthaboon Riverside community, visit the Cathedral of the Immaculate Conception, taste the fruit and shop for gems · Most in-town accommodation is older hotels or guesthouses in the old community, while the newer hotels tend to sit out of town · USABAI Riverside Boutique Hotel fills that gap neatly — a boutique hotel that opened around 2020, set on the Chanthaburi River in the Chanthanimit area, just a short walk or quick drive from the Chanthaboon Riverside.

The hotel is designed around a 'Contemporary Chanthaburi' concept — taking the feel of the town and reinterpreting it in the design · There are 32 rooms across 7 types, each styled and laid out a little differently, from river-view rooms to mountain-view rooms and connecting rooms for families · Most reviews call the rooms larger than expected, clean, and well-equipped — enough power outlets, bedside lights, and a rainshower that several guests single out as satisfyingly strong.
"Big, clean room, very friendly staff at reception, breakfast with some local dishes to try, and an easy stroll to the Chanthaboon Riverside."

The charm here is the riverside space · Behind the hotel a walkway, salas and a small pier run along the Chanthaburi River, a quiet spot to catch the breeze in the evening that feels cut off from the street out front · There's a USABAI Cafe & Eatery and an in-house restaurant, plus a co-working space and a mid-size meeting room for anyone working or holding a small event · Breakfast mixes local and international dishes and is mostly praised for taste, though a few reviews note the spread is smaller than at a big hotel.

Location is USABAI's real advantage · It's in the city, about 300 m from the Centric night market, with the Chanthaboon Riverside, the cathedral and the gem museum all close by · Convenience stores, the Robinson mall and plenty of restaurants are nearby · There's free parking and an EV charger, which is rare for an old-town hotel · If you're driving to Chanthaburi, it's very handy — park at the hotel and explore the city on foot.

On scores, USABAI reviews well · The average across real-guest platforms sits around 8.4 out of 10, with Trip.com as high as about 8.7 and Booking.com around 8 from a few hundred reviews · The repeated praise: spacious clean rooms, friendly staff, the riverside in-city location and good value · The common gripes are that the soi out front still looks plain and not very 'boutique', the air-con in some rooms is noisy during its self-cleaning cycle, and the breakfast choice is limited.

To be straight about it, USABAI is not a luxury beach resort and doesn't try to be · Its appeal is simple: a well-designed, spacious, clean riverside boutique in the city at a price you can justify, with all of Chanthaburi walkable from the door · If your trip is about the Chanthaboon Riverside, the food and the town rather than sleeping on the beach, it fits far better than an out-of-town resort · But if you want a sea setting or a big swimming pool, look at the Chao Lao Beach or Laem Sing areas instead.

A tip from reading plenty of reviews here: ask for a river-view room if you want the full riverside feel, since the mountain-view and inner rooms don't see the water · Spend one evening out on the riverside sala — it's the best-feeling corner of the hotel · And if you come during Chanthaburi's fruit season (around May–June) or a long weekend, book ahead, because good in-town stays are few and fill quickly.

honestSummary: USABAI Riverside Boutique Hotel is one of the best-judged in-city riverside boutiques in Chanthaburi — spacious, well-designed, clean, fairly priced, and walkable to the Chanthaboon Riverside and night market · It isn't a luxury beach resort and the soi out front is plain, but for a drive-yourself trip exploring the town it lands just right.
honestChecks: If you're here mainly for the riverside feel — mountain-view and inner rooms don't see the river → ask for a river-view room when booking, and sit out on the riverside sala in the evening for the full effect.
If you want a beach or a big pool — this is an in-city riverside boutique, not a beachfront resort → for the sea, look at the Chao Lao Beach or Laem Sing areas instead.
If you expect a luxury boutique from the street in — the entrance and soi out front still look plain → set expectations and focus on the rooms and the riverside, which are the real thing.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — USABAI Riverside Boutique Hotel, Chanthaburi

faq.q: Where is USABAI Riverside Boutique Hotel and how do I get there?
faq.a: It sits on the Chanthaburi River in Chanthanimit, Mueang Chanthaburi, right in the city · It's about 300 m from the Centric night market, with the Chanthaboon Riverside, the cathedral and the gem market all a few minutes away · There's free parking and an EV charger, ideal if you drive from Bangkok (about 3.5 hours).

faq.q: How much does USABAI Riverside cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Standard rooms start from about THB 1,000/night in normal periods · There are 32 rooms in 7 styles, including mountain-view rooms, Heaven Sweet river-view rooms, and Leisure Connecting rooms for families · Prices depend on dates and view — compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Is it really a riverside hotel — what's the atmosphere like?
faq.a: Yes · The back of the hotel meets the Chanthaburi River, with a walkway, salas and a pier to sit out by in the evening · The whole hotel follows a Contemporary Chanthaburi design · To see the river from your room, choose a Riverside-view room, as some types are mountain or inner views.

faq.q: Who is it best for — is exploring Chanthaburi town easy?
faq.a: It's best for travellers who want to explore Chanthaburi town, walk the Chanthaboon Riverside, eat well and shop for gems · Park at the hotel and explore on foot · If you're after the sea and a big pool, this isn't it — look at the Chao Lao Beach or Laem Sing areas instead.

faq.q: What are the review scores like, and what are the downsides?
faq.a: The average across real-guest reviews is around 8.4 out of 10 (Trip.com about 8.7, Booking.com around 8) · Common praise: spacious clean rooms, friendly staff, the in-city riverside location and good value · The downsides: the soi out front still looks plain, breakfast choice is limited, and the air-con in some rooms is noisy during its self-cleaning cycle.
